summary: Tested Product Catalog CRUD backend (4/4 pytest passing) and full frontend flow (products page CRUD, autocomplete on /create, header buttons, doctype selector, add/remove items, focus regression). All acceptance criteria met.
action_items: (Optional/minor) React hydration warnings in InvoicePreview: '<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>' and '<tr> cannot be a child of <span>' triggered by data-ve-dynamic wrapper around <tr> inside <tbody>. Functional impact is nil but console gets noisy on /create.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/products.py opens its own MongoClient instead of reusing the shared db connection from server.py — minor but duplicates connection pools per route module.
ProductCreate.price has no bounds validation (negative prices accepted).
InvoicePreview renders <span data-ve-dynamic> around each <tr> inside <tbody> which is invalid HTML and causes React hydration warnings.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_UI_1 / TEST_UI Producto ($25.000) in test user's catalog.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_products.py (4 tests). Auto-cleans TEST_* prefixed products. Login page is at /signin (not /login). Products page uses data-testid add-product-btn, product-code-input, product-description-input, product-price-input (formatted es-CO), product-unit-input, product-save-btn, products-search-input, product-row-{id}, edit-product-btn-{id}, delete-product-btn-{id} (window.confirm auto-accept). Autocomplete in /create uses item-description-0 + product-suggestions-0 + product-suggestion-{id}; selecting fills item-rate-0 with formatted price and recalculates item-amount-0 (with default qty=0, amount is $0 — set qty first to verify). Header mobile buttons: my-products-btn-mobile, document-type-selector-mobile-btn, current-doctype-label. add-item-button focuses new item-description-{i+1}.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this feature.
